content.bridge_context: Introduction to how people earn a living and the different sectors of the economy.

units.title: Earning a Living
units.explanation: Economic activities are those done to earn money and provide goods or services.
units.dual_language_instruction: What does 'occupation' mean? / 'व्यवसाय' का क्या अर्थ है?

units.title: Sectors of Economy
units.explanation: Activities are grouped into Primary (farming), Secondary (manufacturing), and Tertiary (services).
units.dual_language_instruction: Is a farmer in the Primary or Secondary sector? / एक किसान प्राथमिक क्षेत्र में है या द्वितीयक?
